text:
Evan Park: Quickstart failed on my laptop. Followed the Go tutorial, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, ran binary. After ~7s it errored 403 billing_required. SDK printed a couple of 'attempting refresh' lines which is confusing for a static key. Anyone seen this?

Evan Park: logs:
[2026-02-15T11:03:12Z] INFO client: POST /v1/generate
[2026-02-15T11:03:19Z] WARN auth: no refresh token; trying fallback (api_key)
[2026-02-15T11:03:19Z] ERROR client: status=403 code=billing_required workspace=wk_ev123
{"error":"Billing required for workspace wk_ev123"}

Lena Ortiz: Hi Evan 1 quick isolate: can you curl the endpoint with the same key to confirm?

Evan Park: ran curl: HTTP/2 403 with body {"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"Billing required for workspace wk_ev123"}}

Markus Li: That confirms it's a billing gate. @devex-bot show workspace state wk_ev123

devex-bot: workspace wk_ev123 status: credits_exhausted; last_grant: 2025-12-10; payment_method: none

Lena Ortiz: OK it's not an SDK auth bug in isolation, but the SDK should avoid noisy refresh attempts when API key is provided. Filing DX-1140 to short-circuit refresh on static keys and surface actionable error text.

Evan Park: Need a fast unblock to continue integration test. Any short-lived demo key we can use?

Markus Li: I spun up wk_demo_900 and created sk_demo_900 (24h). DM sent.

Evan Park: Demo key works, first call succeeded. Thanks!

Lena Ortiz: Action items: Lena will add a small troubleshooting note in quickstart about billing_required and include the curl command; Markus will attach demo workspace template for internal QA; DX-1140 assigned to SDK team.

Evan Park: Closing this thread, appreciate the help :thumbsup:
